jobs.title: Technical Specialist Production (TSP) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
In dieser Funktion bist du als Technischer Spezialist Produktion TSP (m/w/d) ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres Support-Teams in der Elektronikfertigung.

Du stellst die Anlagenverfügbarkeit durch vorbeugende Wartung sicher, minimierst Stillstände durch nachhaltige Instandhaltungsstrategien und behebst Störungen inklusive Ursachenanalyse. Dabei treibst du kontinuierliche Verbesserungen im Bereich Maintenance voran und entwickelst deine Fachkenntnisse (z. B. im TPS) stetig weiter.

Als technische Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion, Engineering und Entwicklung unterstützt du die Fachbereiche, berätst bei technischen Fragestellungen und wirkst an der Optimierung unserer Anlagen mit.

Mehr über die Rolle

• Sicherstellung der Anlagenverfügbarkeit durch vorbeugende Wartung von Anlagen, Betriebs- und Prüfmitteln

• Minimierung von Stillständen durch nachhaltige Instandhaltungsstrategien und Unterstützung der Maschinenbediener bei grundlegenden Wartungsaufgaben

• Analyse und Behebung von Störungen in der Produktion inklusive Ursachenanalyse

• Kontinuierliche Verbesserung (Continuous Improvement) im Bereich Maintenance

• Technische Schnittstelle zwischen Produktion, Engineering, Entwicklung sowie weiteren Fachbereichen (R&D, NPI, B&I)

• Technische Beratung und Unterstützung der Produktionsabteilungen sowie Mitwirkung bei der Optimierung von Anlagen

• Koordination, Dokumentation und Überwachung von Instandhaltungsmaßnahmen (inkl. LEXA) sowie Einhaltung von Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsvorschriften

• Verwaltung und Beschaffung von Ersatzteilen sowie Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung automatisierter Anlagen und Pikettdienst bei Bedarf

Mehr über dich

• Abgeschlossene technische Berufsbildung (EFZ) im elektronischen Bereich (z. B. Automatiker, Polymechaniker, Elektroniker)

• Erfahrung in der Elektronikproduktion, idealerweise mit Kenntnissen in Lean Management, Supply Chain und SMD/Flip-Chip-Bestückung

• Gute Übersicht über die gesamte Produktionskette sowie idealerweise Erfahrung in der Automatisierung oder Halbleiterfertigung

• Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis, schnelle Auffassungsgabe und bereichsübergreifendes Denken

• Hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein sowie strukturierte und verantwortungsvolle Arbeitsweise

• Erfahrung in der Durchführung von Schulungen sowie in der Einhaltung von Prozessen und Qualitätsstandards

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

• Gute PC-Anwenderkenntnisse (MS Office 365); SAP-Kenntnisse von Vorteil

Mehr über unser Angebot

Als eines der weltweit führenden Unternehmen im Bereich Hörlösungen mit Hauptsitz in der Schweiz legen wir großen Wert auf eine inklusive und wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur.

Wir bieten dir:

• Strukturierte Einarbeitung sowie gezielte interne und externe Weiterbildungen

• Individuelle Entwicklungs- und Wachstumsmöglichkeiten

• Ein modernes Produktionsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswege

• Die Möglichkeit, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten

Descrizione

In questo ruolo, in qualità di Specialista tecnico della produzione TSP (m/f/d), sei una parte fondamentale del nostro team di supporto nella produzione elettronica.

Assicuri la disponibilità degli impianti attraverso la manutenzione preventiva, riduci al minimo i fermi mediante strategie di manutenzione sostenibili e risolvi i guasti, inclusa l’analisi delle cause. Inoltre, promuovi continui miglioramenti nell’ambito della manutenzione e sviluppi costantemente le tue competenze tecniche (ad es. nel TPS).

In qualità di interfaccia tecnica tra produzione, ingegneria e sviluppo, supporti i reparti specialistici, fornisci consulenza su questioni tecniche e contribuisci all’ottimizzazione dei nostri impianti.

Maggiori informazioni sul ruolo

- Garantire la disponibilità degli impianti mediante la manutenzione preventiva di impianti, mezzi operativi e strumenti di prova
- Riduzione al minimo dei tempi di fermo attraverso strategie di manutenzione sostenibili e supporto agli operatori delle macchine nelle attività di manutenzione di base
- Analisi e risoluzione dei problemi nella produzione, inclusa l’analisi delle cause
- Miglioramento continuo (Continuous Improvement) nell'ambito della manutenzione
- Interfaccia tecnica tra produzione, ingegneria, sviluppo e altre aree specialistiche (R&D, NPI, B&I)
- Consulenza tecnica e supporto ai reparti di produzione, nonché collaborazione all’ottimizzazione degli impianti
- Coordinamento, documentazione e supervisione degli interventi di manutenzione (incl. LEXA), nonché rispetto delle norme di qualità e sicurezza
- Gestione e approvvigionamento di pezzi di ricambio, nonché supporto all’ulteriore sviluppo di impianti automatizzati e servizio di picchetto all’occorrenza

Più informazioni su di te

- Completamento della formazione tecnica professionale (EFZ) nel campo elettronico (ad esempio tecnico automazione, polimeccanico, tecnico elettronico)
- Esperienza nella produzione elettronica, idealmente con conoscenze di gestione lean, supply chain e assemblaggio SMD/flip-chip
- Buona panoramica dell'intera catena produttiva e, idealmente, esperienza nell'automazione o nella produzione di semiconduttori
- Forte comprensione tecnica, rapidità di comprensione e pensiero interdipartimentale
- Alta consapevolezza di qualità e un modo di lavorare strutturato e responsabile
- Esperienza nell'organizzazione di corsi di formazione così come nell'aderenza a processi e standard di qualità
- Ottima conoscenza del tedesco e buone competenze scritte e parlate in inglese
- Buone competenze da utente PC (MS Office 365); La conoscenza di SAP è un vantaggio

Maggiori informazioni sulla nostra offerta

Come una delle principali aziende mondiali di soluzioni per l'udito con sede in Svizzera, attribuiamo grande importanza a una cultura aziendale inclusiva e riconoscente.

Ti offriamo:

- Induzione strutturata così come formazione mirata interna ed esterna
- Opportunità di sviluppo e crescita individuale
- Un ambiente produttivo moderno con processi decisionali brevi
- L'opportunità di assumersi responsabilità e modellare attivamente i processi

Description

In this role, you are a central part of our support team in electronics manufacturing as a Technical Production Specialist TSP (m/f/d).

You ensure equipment availability through preventive maintenance, minimize downtime through sustainable maintenance strategies, and resolve malfunctions, including root cause analysis. In doing so, you drive continuous improvements in Maintenance and continuously develop your technical expertise (e.g., in TPS).

As a technical interface between production, engineering, and development, you support the specialist departments, advise on technical issues, and contribute to optimizing our systems.

More about the role

- Ensuring equipment availability through preventive maintenance of equipment, operating resources and testing equipment
- Minimizing downtime through sustainable maintenance strategies and supporting machine operators with basic maintenance tasks
- Analysis and resolution of disruptions in production, including root cause analysis
- Continuous Improvement (Continuous Improvement) in the Maintenance area
- Technical interface between Production, Engineering, Development, and other specialist departments (R&D, NPI, B&I)
- Technical consulting and support for the production departments, as well as involvement in the optimization of equipment
- Coordination, documentation and monitoring of maintenance activities (including LEXA) as well as compliance with quality and safety regulations
- Management and procurement of spare parts, as well as support in the further development of automated systems and on-call service as needed

More about you

- Completed technical vocational training (EFZ) in the electronic field (e.g. automation technician, polymechanic, electronics technician)
- Experience in electronics production, ideally with knowledge of lean management, supply chain and SMD/flip-chip assembly
- Good overview of the entire production chain and, ideally, experience in automation or semiconductor manufacturing
- Strong technical understanding, quick comprehension and cross-departmental thinking
- High quality awareness as well as structured and responsible way of working
- Experience in conducting training courses as well as in adhering to processes and quality standards
- Very good knowledge of German as well as good written and spoken English skills
- Good PC user skills (MS Office 365); SAP knowledge is an advantage

More about our offer

As one of the world's leading hearing solutions companies headquartered in Switzerland, we attach great importance to an inclusive and appreciative corporate culture.

We offer you:

- Structured induction as well as targeted internal and external training
- Individual development and growth opportunities
- A modern production environment with short decision-making processes
- The opportunity to take responsibility and actively shape processes

Description

Dans cette fonction, vous êtes, en tant que spécialiste technique de la production TSP (h/f/d), un élément central de notre équipe de support dans la fabrication électronique.

Vous assurez la disponibilité des installations grâce à une maintenance préventive, réduisez au minimum les arrêts grâce à des stratégies de maintenance durables et remédiez aux pannes, analyse des causes comprise. Ce faisant, vous faites progresser les améliorations continues dans le domaine de la maintenance et développez constamment vos compétences techniques (p. ex. dans le TPS).

En tant qu’interface technique entre la production, l’ingénierie et le développement, vous accompagnez les services spécialisés, les conseillez sur les questions techniques et contribuez à l’optimisation de nos installations.

En savoir plus sur le rôle

- Garantie de la disponibilité des installations grâce à la maintenance préventive des installations, des équipements d’exploitation et des moyens de contrôle
- Minimisation des temps d’arrêt grâce à des stratégies de maintenance durables et accompagnement des opérateurs de machines dans les tâches de maintenance de base
- Analyse et résolution des dysfonctionnements en production, y compris l’analyse des causes
- Amélioration continue (Continuous Improvement) dans le domaine de la maintenance
- Interface technique entre la production, l’ingénierie, le développement ainsi que d’autres services spécialisés (R&D, NPI, B&I)
- Conseil technique et soutien aux services de production, ainsi que participation à l’optimisation des installations
- Coordination, documentation et supervision des opérations de maintenance (y compris LEXA), ainsi que respect des règles de qualité et de sécurité
- Gestion et approvisionnement en pièces de rechange, ainsi que soutien au développement continu d’installations automatisées et service de piquet en cas de besoin

En savoir plus sur vous

- Formation technique professionnelle (ZE) complétée dans le domaine électronique (par exemple technicien en automatisation, polymécanique, technicien en électronique)
- Expérience en production électronique, idéalement avec des connaissances en gestion lean, chaîne d'approvisionnement et assemblage SMD/flip-chip
- Bonne vue d'ensemble de la chaîne de production et, idéalement, expérience en automatisation ou fabrication de semi-conducteurs
- Solide compréhension technique, compréhension rapide et réflexion inter-départementale
- Une haute sensibilisation à la qualité ainsi qu'une manière de travailler structurée et responsable
- Expérience dans la formation ainsi que dans le respect des processus et normes de qualité
- Très bonne connaissance de l'allemand ainsi que de bonnes compétences en anglais écrit et oral
- Bonnes compétences en PC (MS Office 365) ; La connaissance de SAP est un avantage

Plus d'informations sur notre offre

En tant que l'une des principales entreprises mondiales de solutions auditives ayant son siège en Suisse, nous attachons une grande importance à une culture d'entreprise inclusive et reconnaissante.

Nous vous proposons :

- Induction structurée ainsi que formation ciblée interne et externe
- Opportunités de développement et de croissance individuelles
- Un environnement de production moderne avec des processus décisionnels courts
- L'opportunité de prendre des responsabilités et de façonner activement les processus

jobs.title: Software Engineer Embedded AI (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
At Sonova R&D, we are not just developing hearing devices, we are shaping the future of hearing technology. At the heart of this transformation is the deployment and execution of neural networks on our next-generation embedded platform. This requires innovative tools and firmware infrastructure, giving you the opportunity to directly influence the performance of our products.

As our new Software Engineer Embedded AI you will bridge the gap between cutting-edge AI and ultra-low-power embedded systems. You will develop the embedded AI software stack that forms the foundation of our next-generation hearing instruments.

Are you excited to explore new technological territory and play a pivotal role in shaping Sonova’s edge AI capabilities? Join us and help rethink how embedded software is built to enhance people’s hearing experience and quality of life.

More about the role

• Develop firmware for a deeply embedded AI platform operating under strict latency, memory, compute, and energy constraints

• Design, implement, and maintain the embedded AI software stack including optimization for performance, latency, and energy efficiency

• Collaborate with AI and DSP experts to analyze and deploy DNN algorithms in hearing-device applications

• Tailor AI algorithms to the embedded platform and its constraints (e.g., quantization, memory, compute and power)

• Implement prototypes, bring them to production-ready features and integrate them into our system in collaboration with other engineering teams.

• Ensure high software quality through clean-code practices, code reviews, testing, documentation, maintenance, and root-cause analysis

• Continuously improve development methodologies, tools, design patterns, and best practices for efficient ML/DNN development and deployment

More about you

• Degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field

• Strong hands-on experience with embedded C++, Python, and object-oriented programming

• Experience developing and deploying neural networks on embedded systems, including familiarity with deployment frameworks such as TensorFlow Lite, ONNX, TVM, or ExecuTorch

• Knowledge of embedded compilers, micro-NPUs, and system-level simulation

• Experience with CUDA is an advantage

• Knowledge of audio or digital signal processing is an advantage

• Experience in bringing features to products is an advantage

• Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills

More about what we offer

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

Application process

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered.

A Sonova R&D, non stiamo solo sviluppando dispositivi acustici, stiamo plasmando il futuro della tecnologia dell'udito. Al centro di questa trasformazione è la distribuzione e l'esecuzione di reti neurali sulla nostra piattaforma incorporata di nuova generazione. Ciò richiede strumenti innovativi e infrastrutture firmware, dando la possibilità di influenzare direttamente le prestazioni dei nostri prodotti.

Come il nostro nuovo Software Engineer Embedded AI si schiuderà il divario tra l'intelligenza artificiale all'avanguardia e sistemi incorporati a bassa potenza. Si svilupperà lo stack software AI incorporato che forma la base dei nostri strumenti acustici di nuova generazione.

Sei entusiasta di esplorare il nuovo territorio tecnologico e di svolgere un ruolo fondamentale nella modellazione delle capacità AI bordo di Sonova? Unisciti a noi e aiuta a ripensare come il software incorporato è costruito per migliorare l'esperienza uditiva delle persone e la qualità della vita.

Ulteriori informazioni sul ruolo

• Sviluppare il firmware per una piattaforma AI profondamente integrata che opera sotto rigidi vincoli di latenza, memoria, elaborazione e energia

• Progettare, implementare e mantenere lo stack software AI incorporato tra cui ottimizzazione per prestazioni, latenza e efficienza energetica

• Collabora con gli esperti AI e DSP per analizzare e distribuire gli algoritmi DNN in applicazioni per dispositivi acustici

• Algoritmi di Tailor AI alla piattaforma incorporata e ai suoi vincoli (ad esempio, quantizzazione, memoria, calcolo e potenza)

• Prototipi di implementazione, portarli a caratteristiche pronte alla produzione e integrarli nel nostro sistema in collaborazione con altri team di ingegneria.

• Assicurare alta qualità del software attraverso pratiche di codice pulito, recensioni di codice, test, documentazione, manutenzione e analisi root-cause

• Migliorare costantemente le metodologie di sviluppo, gli strumenti, i modelli di progettazione e le migliori pratiche per un efficiente sviluppo e distribuzione ML/DNN

Più di te

• Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria Elettrica, o un campo tecnico correlato

• Forte esperienza pratica con C++, Python e programmazione orientata agli oggetti

• Esperienza di sviluppo e distribuzione di reti neurali su sistemi incorporati, tra cui familiarità con i framework di distribuzione come TensorFlow Lite, ONNX, TVM, o ExecuTorch

• Conoscenza dei compilatori incorporati, micro-NPU e simulazione a livello di sistema

• L'esperienza con CUDA è un vantaggio

• La conoscenza dell'elaborazione del segnale audio o digitale è un vantaggio

• L'esperienza nel portare caratteristiche ai prodotti è un vantaggio

• Inglese fluente, con forti capacità di comunicazione scritte e verbali

Maggiori informazioni su ciò che offriamo

Come uno dei principali fornitori di servizi per l’udito con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura inclusiva. Vogliamo creare un ambiente in cui è possibile bilanciare una carriera di successo con i vostri impegni e interessi al di fuori del lavoro, attraverso il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile. Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di formazione sia per il vostro sviluppo professionale che personale, e ci sono eccezionali opportunità di crescita con i piani di sviluppo individuali.

jobs.title: Hardware Integration Engineer (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
As Hardware Development Engineer , you will contribute to the development of innovative hearing instrument systems, from early concepts and prototypes through hardware integration, testing and product development.

You will develop product-specific hearing system solutions, integrate electronic and electroacoustic subsystems, define transducers and build prototypes to validate new concepts. Working within interdisciplinary agile R&D teams, you will combine expertise in electrical engineering, acoustics, RF and measurement technologies to develop robust, high-quality solutions.

This role offers the opportunity to work hands-on with sophisticated hearing technology while collaborating with diverse experts across R&D and contributing to innovation, knowledge sharing and intellectual property.

More about the role:

• Develop hardware solutions for hearing instrument systems, translating product requirements into robust electronic and electroacoustic designs.

• Integrate hardware subsystems and define electroacoustic transducers to ensure effective performance of the complete hearing system.

• Design and build hearing system prototypes, including hands-on activities such as soldering, gluing and working with small electronic and mechanical components.

• Define and execute hardware measurements and testing, establishing limits, test criteria and quality characteristics for hearing system hardware.

• Develop software tools for measurement systems to support hardware development, testing and validation activities.

• Contribute to the R&D development process, including planning, reviews and refinement of product increments within interdisciplinary agile development teams.

• Collaborate and share knowledge across R&D, actively participating in team activities and technical communities while supporting onboarding and, when required, the hiring process.

• Contribute to innovation and intellectual property, identifying opportunities for new solutions and supporting the IP process while following relevant development procedures and quality standards.

More about you:

• BSc or MSc in Electrical Engineering or a related technical discipline; additional education or expertise in acoustics or audiology is an advantage.

• Very good knowledge of electrical engineering, acoustics, measurement technologies and RF engineering, combined with experience in electronic hardware and wireless system design.

• Practical experience with PCB design, wireless technologies, electronic measurements and hardware prototyping, including soldering and handling small components.

• Experience developing software for controlling measurement equipment is an advantage, with knowledge of tools and technologies such as MATLAB, Arduino, C# and Python.

• A structured, system-oriented and quality-conscious approach, combined with creativity, technical curiosity and the ability to develop pragmatic solutions to complex engineering challenges.

• Strong self-leadership and accountability, with a proactive approach to learning, knowledge sharing, continuous improvement and transparent collaboration.

• Excellent teamwork and communication skills, with the ability to contribute effectively within distributed, interdisciplinary and culturally diverse development teams.

• Very good English and German, both written and spoken; experience with project or functional leadership and tools such as Confluence, Microsoft Teams and MS Office is advantageous.

More about what we offer:

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

Leading our global Audiological Development organization, you will bring together hearing functions and system steering, audiological individualization, and performance innovation to create coherent, high-quality solutions for people with hearing needs.
In return for your deep audiological expertise and ability to lead complex R&D organizations, you will have the opportunity to influence the future of hearing technology at a strategic level. You will work across science, engineering, platforms and products, develop talented teams and professionals with subject matter expertise, and turn innovative audiological concepts into solutions that can make a tangible difference to people's lives.

• Partner with Audiological Research Centers, Functional Leaders and the Audiological Domain Architect to translate new concepts and validated performance innovations into scalable, system-ready solutions.

jobs.description:
As an Automation Engineer , you will develop and implement advanced manufacturing equipment and automation solutions used across Sonova’s global Operations, R&D and Regional Centers.

You will take automation projects from initial concept and feasibility assessment through equipment development, supplier coordination and deployment into production. Working closely with R&D, industrialization teams, manufacturing sites and external equipment suppliers, you will evaluate technical solutions and ensure that manufacturing equipment is reliable, scalable, cost-effective and ready for volume production.

The role combines industrial automation, manufacturing engineering and project responsibility. Your main focus will be the development of new manufacturing equipment, complemented by adapting existing systems for new products as well as providing technical support, optimization and troubleshooting for existing solutions.

More about the role:

• Lead automation and manufacturing equipment projects from concept and feasibility assessment through development, verification and deployment into production.

• Develop new automation solutions and adapt existing manufacturing equipment to support new products and manufacturing processes.

• Coordinate equipment projects, including timelines, costs, risks, technical requirements, suppliers and relevant internal stakeholders.

• Evaluate and integrate technologies such as robotics, machine vision and data-driven solutions to improve process control, reliability and traceability.

• Define requirements and collaborate with external automation partners and equipment suppliers to deliver technically sound, compliant and cost-effective solutions.

• Analyze existing manufacturing equipment and processes to identify opportunities for automation, optimization and improved scalability.

• Support equipment implementation, troubleshooting and continuous improvement in collaboration with global manufacturing teams.

• Where needed, contribute to mechanical concepts, 3D models, fixtures and proof-of-concept solutions during feasibility assessments.

More about you:

Must-haves:

• Degree in Automation Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related technical discipline (MSc, BSc, FH, HF or equivalent).

• At least 3 years of relevant professional experience in industrial automation and manufacturing equipment, ideally within medtech, life sciences, micromechanics, microelectronics, precision manufacturing, electronic consumer products or a comparable manufacturing environment.

• Good mechanical understanding and practical exposure to mechanical design and/or 3D modelling in an equipment or manufacturing environment.

• Experience taking responsibility for equipment or automation projects, or significant project workstreams, from technical evaluation toward implementation.

• Strong analytical and interdisciplinary thinking, with the ability to structure complex technical challenges and develop practical, production-ready solutions.

• Independent and structured working style, combined with strong communication and collaboration skills in a cross-functional and international environment.

• Fluent English and at least B2-level German.

Nice-to-haves:

• Experience leading equipment development projects and coordinating cross-functional teams or external automation suppliers.

• Experience with 3D CAD, ideally PTC Creo, including fixtures, prototypes or proof-of-concept solutions.

• Knowledge of PLC systems and IEC 61131-3 programming, robotics, machine vision and/or manufacturing data solutions.

• Advanced experience with automation solutions for fine-mechanical or other high-precision manufacturing processes.

• Project management training or certification.

More about what we offer:

As one of the world’s leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we’re committed to building an inclusive culture. We want to create an environment where you can balance a successful career with your commitments and interests outside of work, through our flexible hybrid working model. We offer a wide range of training opportunities for both your professional and personal development, and there are exceptional growth opportunities with individual development plans.

Application process:

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, is looking forward to receiving your application via our online job application platform, including your CV and cover letter. For this vacancy, only direct applications will be considered.

• Analizzare le apparecchiature e i processi di produzione esistenti per identificare le opportunità di automazione, ottimizzazione e scalabilità migliorata.

• Supporto implementazione, risoluzione dei problemi e miglioramento continuo in collaborazione con i team di produzione globali.

• Buona comprensione meccanica e esposizione pratica alla progettazione meccanica e/o alla modellazione 3D in un'apparecchiatura o in un ambiente di produzione.

• Esperienza che si assume la responsabilità di progetti di automazione o attrezzature, o significativi flussi di lavoro di progetto, dalla valutazione tecnica all'implementazione.

• Forte pensiero analitico e interdisciplinare, con la capacità di strutturare complesse sfide tecniche e sviluppare soluzioni pratiche e pronte alla produzione.

• Stile di lavoro indipendente e strutturato, combinato con forti capacità di comunicazione e collaborazione in un ambiente interfunzionale e internazionale.

• Inglese fluente e almeno tedesco di livello B2.

Bello da portare:

• Scopri i principali progetti di sviluppo di attrezzature e coordina team interfunzionali o fornitori di automazione esterni.

• Esperienza con CAD 3D, idealmente PTC Creo, compresi i dispositivi, i prototipi o le soluzioni proof-of-concept.

• Conoscenza dei sistemi PLC e della programmazione IEC 61131-3, robotica, visione della macchina e/o soluzioni di dati di produzione.

• Esperienza avanzata con soluzioni di automazione per processi di produzione a precisione meccanica o ad alta precisione.

• Formazione o certificazione di gestione del progetto.

Maggiori informazioni su ciò che offriamo:

Come uno dei principali fornitori di servizi per l’udito con sede in Svizzera, ci impegniamo a costruire una cultura inclusiva. Vogliamo creare un ambiente in cui è possibile bilanciare una carriera di successo con i vostri impegni e interessi al di fuori del lavoro, attraverso il nostro modello di lavoro ibrido flessibile. Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di formazione sia per il vostro sviluppo professionale che personale, e ci sono eccezionali opportunità di crescita con i piani di sviluppo individuali.

Magdalena Suszek, Talent Acquisition Partner, non vede l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione tramite la nostra piattaforma di applicazione del lavoro online, compreso il vostro CV e lettera di copertura. Per questa vacanza, saranno considerate solo applicazioni dirette.

As a Product Cybersecurity Expert , you will play a key role in ensuring cybersecurity is embedded into the development of Sonova's connected hearing solutions—from embedded software and mobile applications to cloud-based services.

Working closely with software engineers, product teams, architects, quality, and regulatory experts, you'll help integrate security into every stage of the product development lifecycle. Rather than focusing on operational security, you'll enable engineering teams to build secure products by design, balancing innovation, usability, compliance, and customer trust.

If you have a strong software engineering background and have expanded your expertise into product cybersecurity, this is an opportunity to shape technologies that improve the lives of millions of people worldwide.

More about the role

• Integrate cybersecurity throughout the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) for connected medical devices, embedded software, mobile applications, and cloud services.

• Lead threat modeling activities, cybersecurity risk assessments, and mitigation planning together with global R&D teams.

• Partner with software engineering teams to embed security into development workflows, DevSecOps practices, and CI/CD pipelines.

• Coordinate product vulnerability management activities, including assessment, prioritization, remediation tracking, and post-market monitoring.

• Support regulatory submissions and quality processes by preparing cybersecurity documentation and evidence.

• Advise engineering, product management, quality, and regulatory teams on practical, risk-based cybersecurity decisions.

• Promote a security-first mindset by coaching teams, supporting security champions, and driving continuous improvement across R&D.

More about you

Essential

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent practical experience).

• 5+ years of experience in software engineering, software architecture, product development, Secure SDLC, or a comparable software development environment.

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience in product cybersecurity or application security.

• Strong understanding of Secure Software Development Lifecycle (Secure SDLC) and how cybersecurity integrates into modern software development.

• Experience working closely with software development teams throughout the product lifecycle.

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex security topics to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Professional working proficiency in English.

Nice to have

• Experience developing software for medical devices or other regulated industries.

• Experience with DevSecOps and security integration into CI/CD pipelines.

• Knowledge of cybersecurity standards and regulations such as IEC 81001-5-1, IEC 62304, ISO 14971, MDR, FDA, GDPR, CRA or similar frameworks.

• Security certifications such as CISSP, CSSLP, GIAC, or equivalent.

• Experience with cloud security, cryptography, authentication technologies, or software supply chain security.

• Familiarity with Privacy by Design principles, AI agent security, and AI-supported development environments.

More about what we offer

As one of the world's leading hearing care providers headquartered in Switzerland, we're committed to building an inclusive culture where innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning thrive.

Joining Sonova means working with highly skilled international teams developing technologies that genuinely improve people's quality of life. We offer a flexible hybrid working model, extensive learning and development opportunities, and clear career paths that support both your professional and personal growth.

Here, you'll have the opportunity to shape secure, connected healthcare technologies while working in an environment where your ideas are valued and your impact is visible.
